comment: Same amount of reading as all other Core sections--not under professor's control. But Glancy made sure we did the reading. Some students resented her high standards. Some days I did too, but I learned more about writing--and revising--than I would have with a more mellow prof. Sorry UR couldn't hold on to her. Excellent prof, quirky sense of humor.

This class is horrible.  Core is terrible and she doesn't make it any better.  She is not fair, mean, and doesn't care about 80% of the kids in the class.  Good luck to whoever has to deal with her.  Thank God I am not studying religion.

worst teacher ever, tons of work and essays on top of weekly reading assignments. regarding the formal essays, she was extremely vague on what she wanted. never gave you prompt-open ended essays always. took joy in being the 'annoying teacher'. not afraid to hurt your feelings.
Way to much reading. Her grading is also pretty vague, it's not really clear what she wants.
